status: FROZEN_FOR_INTERFACE; new experiment not yet run
scope: historical rolling backtest, not prospective confirmation
boundary_rule: integer floor of n_rows times each fraction; half-open target intervals
origin_rule: origin_id is zero-based target start index; only include if all H target indices lie inside its segment and target values are known
decision_halves: split decision target interval at floor((cal_end+dec_end)/2); discard crossing windows
preprocessing: fit statistics on train targets only; refit after route freeze may use train+cal+dec only

selection.calibration: minimum MSE numeric fallback and candidate hyperparameters
selection.decision: candidate decision MSE strictly less than fallback; both target-disjoint halves strictly improve; row-null empirical p <= 0.025
selection.tie_break: lowest decision MSE then lexical candidate ID
selection.test: evaluate once after frozen route is written

uncertainty.method: moving block bootstrap on paired per-origin mean loss difference

evidence_requirement: snapshot SHA256, feature manifest SHA256, prediction manifest SHA256, origin list and frozen route per task; missing full evidence yields PARTIAL only
